item.description:
Security and reliability fixes from an audit of the app, the Rust core and the release pipeline.
### Fixed
- Sparkle update feeds must now be signed, and releases are gated and the supply chain hardened. - Links, sign-out, caches and playback restore are hardened against untrusted input. - Playback ownership, validation, log redaction and size caps are stricter in the core. - Newer Spotify Connect pushes are no longer overwritten, root-list inserts retry safely, and failed owner lookups are remembered. - A broken metadata cache is reopened and stale entries are pruned. - Unanswered crash reports survive quitting the app. - Restarting Connect waits for the previous shutdown, and the scrubber follows the playback rate. - Selection-tint swizzling is narrower, and a missing selector is caught in debug builds. - The sign-in log shows the port the listener actually bound. - Devices are listed from the Web API until the first Connect cluster push. - Title and artist lines in Now Playing no longer collapse or blank. - The volume pop-up stays open longer while the pointer crosses to it, so slow pointer movement no longer closes it.
### Changed
- The theme cycle pauses while the app is inactive. - Podcast episode progress pages load concurrently. - Dependencies updated: rustls, time and other Cargo crates, and librespot to its latest upstream.

### Added
- Settings switch to hide the queue and lyrics panel in full-window Now Playing.
### Fixed
- The page play button shows pause while its playlist, album or show is playing. - Settings form dividers use the system separator color. - The player bar picks its accessory layout from the bar width, so it settles when the queue closes. - The compact sidebar hides the equalizer on the playing row. - Artist tiles on Home show square artwork.
### Changed
- The menu bar mini-player opens the window from its artwork instead of a separate button.

First release: a native macOS Spotify client (Premium account required).
### Added
- Playback, queue, search, library, playlists, podcasts and lyrics, with Spotify Connect, media keys, crossfade, menu bar and Dock controls. - DMG releases, self-signed and not notarized (PBI-901). - Automatic updates with Sparkle, with an opt-in beta channel (PBI-902). - Homebrew cask in the project tap: `brew install --cask sapiev/veya/veya` (PBI-903).
